paragraphs: I'm Bamzolin, a self-taught graphic designer working under Bamzolin Labs. My approach is rooted in intentional visual storytelling — bold, high-contrast compositions that carry emotional weight, whether I'm building a brand identity, an app icon, or a campaign visual. Alongside design, I bring a Mechanical Engineering background into my process, which shows up as precision in the details: grid systems, geometry, and production specs that hold up at any scale.

My work spans branding and visual identity for platforms like PrymeKids, an educational space for children, as well as personal and community projects that lean into symbolism and narrative depth. I care about the story behind every project as much as the final output — every color, shape, and layout choice is made to serve something bigger.

case_studies.approach: I rebuilt the brochure content as a system of infographics, then extended that system into two ongoing content formats so the brand had a consistent voice across posts and stories, not just one-off graphics.
